label: Frequently Asked
heading: FAQs
subtext: Got questions? We've gathered the most common answers to help you understand how we work.

faqs.question: What types of projects does Shiv Interior take on?
faqs.answer: We design and build CEO cabins, conference rooms, reception desks, workstations, lab and education setups, wardrobes & storage, sofas, and PV/LGST structures — essentially every kind of workspace furniture a company needs.

faqs.question: Do you work with companies of any size?
faqs.answer: Yes. From a single CEO cabin for a founder to full-floor office fit-outs for large enterprises — our process scales to fit your team, timeline, and budget.

faqs.question: Can I see materials and finishes before I commit?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We share curated material samples, finish swatches, and 3D walkthroughs during the design phase so you can sign off on every detail before production begins.

faqs.question: How involved will we be in the process?
faqs.answer: You'll be involved at every milestone — discovery, concept, material selection, production updates, and final installation. We keep the workflow transparent and collaborative.

faqs.question: What's your typical project timeline?
faqs.answer: Most projects run between 4 and 12 weeks depending on scope. We share a clear schedule after the discovery call so you know exactly what happens when.

faqs.question: Do you handle installation on-site?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our team manages delivery, on-site installation, and final snagging end-to-end, so you can focus on running your business while we handle the build.

faqs.question: Where are you based, and do you travel?
faqs.answer: We're based in Mumbai and serve clients across Maharashtra and India. For larger projects outside the region, we travel — get in touch and we'll confirm feasibility.

faqs.question: How do we get started with Shiv Interior?
faqs.answer: Send us a message through the form above. We'll set up a discovery call to understand your space, your team, and your vision — and follow up with a tailored proposal within 48 hours.
